body: Real-machine checks with real setup-tokens, 2026-10-16 (LOGINS_SPEC 12.1): V1 PASS, `claude auth status` reports authMethod oauth_token when CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is set, even in a home with its own login, with no prompt. V2 FAIL, setup-tokens are inference-only: /api/oauth/usage and /api/oauth/profile answer 403 permission_error (scope user:profile), but /v1/messages returns anthropic-ratelimit-unified-* headers (led to D14). V3 lifetime one year from creation; revoke at claude.ai Settings > Claude Code / connected apps (not otherwise verified). V4 PASS, no file in the home changes after a run on the env token. V5 (Codex API key env var) not run.
